results.note: Unavailable (status.py:52-60) and Error (status.py:63-72) are frozen slots=True dataclasses with only reason/detail/status fields — no 'value' field exists, so __slots__ makes attribute access fail. tests/test_status.py:13-21 constructs both and asserts pytest.raises(AttributeError) on `.value` for each — a real, assertive test, and the 'test' gate reports exit 0.

Ok requires source_timestamp with no default (status.py:28-37) and __post_init__ calls _require_source_timestamp, which raises TypeError if it isn't a datetime. tests/test_status.py:24-29 asserts TypeError both when source_timestamp is omitted entirely and when it's explicitly None — genuine coverage of 'no provenance in time cannot be built'.

Reason enum (status.py:9-15) has exactly NOT_DEFINABLE, PAYWALLED, FETCH_FAILED, NOT_FETCHED. tests/test_status.py:32-47 asserts the enum's value-set equals exactly that set, and that Unavailable/Error reject a missing reason (TypeError from dataclass) and a non-Reason string reason (TypeError from _require_reason's isinstance check) — a real assertive test, not a stub.

All four outcome classes are @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) (status.py:28,40,52,63). tests/test_status.py:50-81 is parametrized over one instance of each of Ok, Stale, Unavailable, Error and asserts setattr on a real field raises dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError — genuine mutation-rejection coverage for every variant.

Deterministic gate 'uv run mypy ingest --strict' exits 0 (also reported directly as the US-003-C5 gate). Caveat: this pass is currently vacuous for the 'exhaustively handled at every use site' half of the criterion — grep across the repo shows zero call sites that consume the Result union (no fetcher imports ingest.status yet); the story's own notes explicitly scope this story to 'Types and their tests only, no fetcher or database code', so there is nothing yet to exhaustively match over. The criterion is satisfied by its stated method (the mypy --strict gate) but the exhaustive-handling claim is unverifiable until a consuming use site exists in a later story.
